Company Press Release

SAN ANTONIO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 19, 1997--A combined federal, county and city task force was successful this week in arresting known drug dealers in a major Texas city. The sting operation was the culmination of many hours of surveillance and months of intelligence gathering, resulting in the seizure of 240 pounds of marijuana.

The interdiction was dependent upon the utilization of ATX Technologies' OnGuard(R) Tracker, which provided to law enforcement officials live, accurate information on the suspects' location during the operation. Narcotics officers involved in the sting were ``delighted with the performance of the OnGuard Tracker'' and have plans to continue use of this technology in future operations.

ATX Technologies, Inc., located in San Antonio is the leading provider of vehicle tracking, personal security and directional assistance for the aftermarket of personal automobiles. ATX markets its products to consumers as well as truck fleets and anyone needing to track or locate heavy equipment. ATX Technologies is the only company of its kind in the industry with complete vertical integration from the design, manufacturing, sales and Response Center. Each member of the OnGuard family of products--the OnGuard LS, LA and CP--can be installed in any vehicle to protect owners against theft and other crimes, and provide convenience services. There are more than 150 OnGuard dealers nationwide. Information on dealer locations is available by calling 1-800-466-4827.
